description: Patch interval, trigger, params, webhook_url or mailbox on an existing feed.

bitfeed_token.description: BitFeed account token (btf_…). Also accepted as Authorization: Bearer. Omit on the first create_feed to open an account; the token is returned once.

trigger.description: Trigger object when mode is trigger. type is one of btc_move (percent, optional window_seconds), btc_threshold (above and/or below in USD), weather_alert (location), airport_delay (airport, optional min_delay_minutes). Optional max_fires, expires_at, cooldown_seconds.

name: update_feed
title: Update a BitFeed feed
